misconfigurations.title: Email-based self-registration is enabled

evidence.detail: account sign-up form is served to anonymous users

misconfigurations.recommendation: Disable self-registration (Site administration > Plugins > Authentication > Self registration) unless required.

misconfigurations.title: Guest login button is shown

evidence.detail: login page offers 'Log in as a guest'

misconfigurations.recommendation: Hide the guest login button (guestloginbutton) and disable guest access unless content is meant to be public.

misconfigurations.title: Web services token endpoint is enabled
misconfigurations.recommendation: Enable web services and the mobile service only if used; enforce strong passwords and rate limiting on /login/token.php.

misconfigurations.title: Debug messages are displayed to visitors

evidence.detail: error page shows developer debugging output (Debug info:)

misconfigurations.recommendation: Set debug to NONE/MINIMAL and disable debugdisplay on production sites.

misconfigurations.title: Moodle data directory (dataroot) is reachable over HTTP
misconfigurations.recommendation: Move the dataroot outside the web root; it holds uploaded files, sessions and caches.

misconfigurations.title: Version control metadata is exposed
misconfigurations.recommendation: Deny access to dot directories (.git, .svn, .hg) in the web server configuration.

misconfigurations.title: Backup or editor copy of config.php is downloadable
misconfigurations.recommendation: Delete the file, rotate the database password and salts it contains, and deny backup extensions in the web server.

misconfigurations.title: Developer, test or upgrade-notes files are downloadable
misconfigurations.recommendation: Deny access to composer/npm manifests, upgrade notes, tests and fixtures as recommended by the Moodle security docs (or serve only the public/ directory on Moodle 5.1+).

misconfigurations.title: Installer or upgrade page is reachable
misconfigurations.recommendation: Complete the installation/upgrade, set $CFG->upgradekey, and block install.php once installed.

notes: plugin advisories are not matched: no structured, redistributable plugin advisory source is bundled
